violation_type.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Tire Swings - No Overlap (26 TAC §746.4809(b))
violation_type.short_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Tire Swings - No Overlap
violation_type.typical_finding: A multi-axis swing didn't have large enough use zones around it. The swing was removed during the inspection.
